newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan buys July HSFO, retenders for Aug-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys July HSFO, retenders for Aug-Sept.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has purchased up to four fuel oil cargoes for July delivery, and retendered its August and September demand, an industry source said on Thursday.
Pakistan awarded two fixed cargoes of 60,000-tonnes of 180-cst 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil and another two on an optional basis.
The first fixed cargo was awarded to United Arab Emirates trader Fal Oil at $9.48 per tonne over Mideast spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight basis to Fotco.
Another fixed and two optional cargoes were awarded to East African Maritime at a premium of $9.84.
Pakistan also bought six 25,000-tonne cargoes of 1.0 percent sulphur fuel oil from East African Maritime at a premium of $27.44 per tonne over Mideast spot quotes c+f Keamari.
The two August low sulphur cargoes are fixed while for September, two are fixed and two optional.
"The Ministry has asked for offers again for August and September cargoes because the premiums were higher," the source said.
He said its high sulphur fuel oil purchases for July delivery was "a priority but there is sufficient time for August and September".

The fresh tender for 3.5 percent sulphur fuel oil August and September supplies which closes on June 30 and offers are valid until July 10, seeks two firm and two optional 60,000-tonne cargoes for each month.
